result.markdown:
If you have slipped and fallen in a shopping centre in Brisbane, you are dealing with a **public liability claim** (premises liability).[lawconnect.com](https://lawconnect.com/en-au/find/public-liability-and-claims/qld/brisbane-city-4000#:~:text=%2807%29%20562..%20Public%20liability%20claims%20expertise%20encompasses,financial%20barriers%20while%20providing%20free%20initial%20consultations.) Because shopping centres are managed by major commercial entities or landlords with robust insurance and corporate legal teams, it is usually vital to have an experienced personal injury lawyer who specializes in public liability.

Many established personal injury law firms in Brisbane handle slip-and-fall claims on a **"No Win, No Fee"** basis (meaning you don't pay legal fees unless your claim is successful).[www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/injury-illness/public-place-injury/slip-and-fall-lawyers-brisbane/#:~:text=Our%20team%20is%20here%20to%20guide%20you,and%20determine%20your%20eligibility%20for%20a%20claim.) ### Key Steps to Protect Your Claim Right Now:

Before or while consulting a lawyer, ensure you have taken (or take) the following steps, as shopping centre public liability claims require proving that the occupier or management was negligent:

1.  **Report the Incident:** If you haven't already, report the fall to the shopping centre management or security and request a copy of the incident report.
2.  **Preserve Evidence:**
    * Take photos of the exact spot where you fell and what caused it (e.g., a spill, leaking roof, uneven floor, or lack of warning signs).
    * Keep the shoes and clothing you were wearing (unwashed, if applicable) in case they are needed for inspection.
3.  **Seek Medical Attention:** See a doctor immediately to document your injuries. Medical notes are the foundation of any compensation claim.
4.  **Gather Details:** Keep track of witness contact information, medical bills, receipts, and notes on how the injury has affected your ability to work or perform daily tasks.
